Subject: Recap: MedCord pilot — authorization path & contract handoff

Thanks again for the call earlier — quick recap and proposed contract handoff path so we can align next steps.

High-level summary
- Goal: 6-week pilot (10k tokens/day) for clinical search + routing integration.
- Decision criteria: latency SLA <= 250ms P95, data residency in us-east, SOC2 evidence for procurement.

Stakeholder map (from call)
- Economic buyer: Anita Mehra (CFO) — final signatory on pilot spend
- Procurement / Vendor ops: Priya Desai — contract checklist owner
- Technical lead: Sanjay Rao (CTO) — integration & acceptance

Proposed contract routing (in order)
1) NDA — quick exec, simple one-way so procurement can share docs (attach draft). Expect turnaround 48–72 hours.
2) MSA (pilot terms) — Ben to own redline sequencing; initial redline expected within 3–5 business days.
3) DPA — parallel review with MSA, target 2–3 business days after initial MSA pass.

Immediate asks / next steps
- Priya / Sanjay: confirm Anita is the correct economic buyer and who should sign (anita@medcord.com).
- Ben: can you take point on MSA/DPA sequencing and confirm target turn times?
- Rishi: will set up a 30-min legal sync once Ben confirms availability.

Attachments: [Attachment: NDA_MedCord_v1.pdf (pdf)]

Thanks,
Irene Choi

-Sanjay

Irene / Team — I can own the legal sequence. Quick plan and expected SLAs below. I will be primary legal contact and will loop Specialists as needed.

Planned flow & estimated turn times
- NDA (current draft attached): I will send a mutual NDA option and a one-way. Expect 24–48 hours for execution if they accept; expect 48–96 hours if countered.
- MSA (pilot terms): I will produce an initial redline within 3 business days after NDA is in place. If they provide redlines, plan a 5-business-day window for negotiation to reach a working pilot MSA.
- DPA: Parallel review — initial draft in 2 business days, finalization depends on data mappings and can be 3–5 business days.
- Evidence requests (SOC2, penetration tests): Please ask Priya to push SOC2 report; we can provide a limited security pack in 24 hours once procurement signs NDA.

Attachments: [Attachment: MSA_DRAFT_v1.docx]

Blockers / notes for sales
- If procurement insists on custom indemnity or broad liability caps, that will require escalation (legal + finance) and add ~1 week. Flag any absolute must-haves from MedCord now.
- If Anita (CFO) requires purchase order or special billing terms, we will coordinate with Finance — include their contact ASAP.

Irene — I will send the mutual NDA and the pilot MSA template to Priya and Sanjay by EOD.
